title: GA readiness checklist for Private upgrade/rollback (runbooks, SLOs, dashboards, support enablement)
creator: Talia Benson
description:
Goal
Ship GA for the "Private upgrade + rollback mechanism" only after operational readiness gates are met across Release Eng, SRE, Support, and PS.

This issue is the GA gatekeeper checklist (single place to track: runbook completeness, upgrade time targets, dashboards/alerts, support enablement, and final sign-offs).

Scope
- Runbook + operator UX completeness (interactive and non-interactive flows)
- Upgrade/rollback time targets and how we measure them (and what environments they apply to)
- Required dashboards/alerts and their alert thresholds
- Support enablement: diagnostics bundle contents, intake workflow, escalation, and customer comms templates
- Release gating criteria and sign-off owners

Non-goals
- Implementing missing features (should be tracked in the dependent tickets)
- Adding new deployment modes beyond VPC and on-prem

Links
- Confluence runbook: sources/confluence/eng-sre/runbooks/private-upgrade-runbook.json
- Day-2 ops (observability + diagnostics): sources/confluence/eng-private-deployments/day-2-ops/upgrade-observability-and-diagnostics.json
- PRD: sources/linear/product-management/PM-482.json

Required GA artifacts (must be linked in release notes)
- Customer docs (Private upgrades + diagnostics collection): redwood-docs PR_522
- Installer docs/CLI help: redwood-private-installer PR_418 / PR_433 / PR_444
- SRE runbook (step-by-step + rollback + failure modes)
- Dashboards/alerts in observability-pack PR_311
- Incident workflow updates: incident-bot PR_88

GA gating checklist (must be checked off before enabling feature flag default-on)

A) Runbook completeness (Owner: Rafael Mendes, Approver: Sean Gallagher)
- [ ] Runbook includes: prerequisites, maintenance window guidance, expected step ordering, and what "safe abort" means
- [ ] Runbook includes explicit rollback safety rules (forward-only migrations, schema guardrails)
- [ ] Runbook includes what to monitor during upgrade (dashboards + key metrics) and how to interpret common alarms
- [ ] Runbook includes copy/pastable commands for:
  - prechecks (including --json output)
  - upgrade plan / dry-run
  - upgrade execute
  - rollback (manual)
  - collect diagnostics bundle
- [ ] Runbook includes "when to stop" / escalation criteria (Support + SRE handoff)
- [ ] Runbook validated end-to-end on staging Private environment using current release candidate bundle

B) Upgrade time targets + measurement (Owner: Leila Farouk, Approver: Connor O'Brien)
Define targets as "p50 / p95" for a reference deployment.
Reference deployment definition (for GA reporting):
- VPC: EKS (or equivalent), 3 control-plane nodes, 2 runtime pools, external DB, standard observability pack
- On-prem: 3-node k8s cluster, local registry mirror, offline bundle import

Targets (proposed GA):
- [ ] Precheck runtime: p95 <= 3 minutes (excluding connectivity failures)
- [ ] Backup step runtime: p95 <= 15 minutes for control-plane DB snapshot + verify (VPC); <= 20 minutes on-prem
- [ ] Upgrade execution (excluding customer maintenance approval wait): p95 <= 45 minutes for reference deployment
- [ ] Rollback RTO: service health restored p95 <= 30 minutes (when rollback is allowed by migration policy)
- [ ] Document what can extend timelines (PV snapshots, slow registry pulls, etc.) and how operators should plan maintenance windows
- [ ] CI evidence: failure-injection matrix includes at least 6 scenarios with timings captured (see ENG-2322)
- [ ] Telemetry: step duration metrics emitted per step with correlation id (ties to ENG-2321)

C) Dashboards + alerts (Owner: Aisha Bello, Approver: Allison Grant)
Required dashboards (per-customer + per-upgrade run):
- [ ] Upgrade step duration (histograms) + top offenders
- [ ] Upgrade failure counts by step + error class
- [ ] Rollback triggers (auto/manual) + outcome
- [ ] Upgrade concurrency / in-flight runs (to detect accidental multi-run)
- [ ] Component health gates: control plane readiness, gateway readiness, runtime pool readiness

Required alerting (noise-controlled; actionability required):
- [ ] Alert: upgrade run failed (page on-call for customer envs in managed staging; for customer-run upgrades, notify Support channel + ticket)
- [ ] Alert: step duration anomaly (e.g., >3x baseline for backup/migrations) -> warn (non-page) + include run id
- [ ] Alert: rollback executed -> warn + audit link
- [ ] Alert: repeated precheck failures for same customer within 24h -> Support follow-up

Operational requirements:
- [ ] Dashboard links embedded into runbook and into diagnostics bundle output
- [ ] Incident-bot automatically tags upgrade-related incidents and includes diagnostics location when present

D) Support enablement + diagnostics (Owner: Dev Patel, Approver: Owen Phillips)
- [ ] Support intake doc updated: required artifacts to request from customer (installer version, bundle manifest, precheck JSON, diagnostics tarball)
- [ ] Diagnostics bundle includes (minimum GA):
  - precheck report (json + human)
  - upgrade plan graph + resolved versions
  - step timing summary
  - installer logs (structured)
  - recent k8s events + describe for critical pods
  - last N lines of pod logs for: control plane, gateway, upgrade job, migrations job
- [ ] Clear mapping: error class -> recommended next action (retry vs rollback vs escalate)
- [ ] Escalation flow defined for:
  - signing/verification failures
  - snapshot permission failures
  - migration forward-only block
  - partial rollout / readiness gate timeout
- [ ] Customer-facing comms templates available (maintenance window, failure notification, data collection)

E) Release gating + sign-offs (Owner: Connor O'Brien, Approvers: Sean Gallagher + Marcus Lin + Vivek Kulkarni)
- [ ] Feature flag plan documented (beta -> GA; default off -> default on)
- [ ] Compatibility matrix enforced in installer (ties to ENG-2315)
- [ ] Security sign-off: artifact signing + verification + audit log events (ties to ENG-2324)
- [ ] Beta exit criteria met (ties to ENG-2325): at least 2 successful upgrades, 1 successful rollback drill, no Sev1/Sev2 open
- [ ] Known limitations listed in release notes (forward-only migrations; no guaranteed zero-downtime; PV snapshots optional)

Current status summary
- Runbook: draft complete, needs final "rollback safety" section aligned to migration metadata behavior
- Dashboards: implemented in observability-pack, pending alert tuning based on staging rehearsal
- Support: diagnostics bundle contents largely covered; Support intake doc needs final screenshots + sample outputs
- Time targets: baseline numbers captured from rehearsal #1, need p95 from additional runs

Open questions
1) For customer-run upgrades (Private), do we page SRE on upgrade failure, or route to Support first with an auto-created ticket?
2) For on-prem air-gapped, do we require a separate GA checklist item validating offline import on two k8s flavors (kubeadm + OpenShift), or treat OpenShift as "best effort" in v1?
3) What is the GA threshold for "precheck false positives"? (e.g., storage class detection edge cases)
acceptance_criteria: All GA gating checklist sections A-E are checked off with links to evidence (runbook, dashboards, sample diagnostics, CI runs).
Upgrade/rollback time targets are explicitly documented with p50/p95 from at least 5 staging runs and 2 beta customer runs.
Support enablement is complete: intake checklist + escalation matrix + sample diagnostics bundle validated by Support on-call.
Dashboards/alerts are live with tuned thresholds and linked from the runbook; alert routes are tested once in staging.
Security sign-off recorded for signing/verification behavior and audit logging coverage for upgrade/rollback actions.
